evidence.title: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts

summary: A team of AI scientists has proposed a stepwise hyperparameter transfer method that reduces computational overhead when scaling mixture‑of‑experts architectures. The approach promises faster training and lower costs for massive models without sacrificing performance.
title: Researchers Introduce Compute‑Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer Technique for Scaling Large Mixture‑of‑Experts Models
